title: fix(app-shell): AI change card names a published object or field by its draft label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34629

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfrh8TiPJf1i2kMSoa (os-dev for area o3-H)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建对话的变更确认卡，对「已发布、但草稿里改了标签」的对象或字段，改为显示草稿里的新标签；草稿没改的仍显示发布版标签。
- 为什么改：确认卡原先查到发布版元数据就不再看草稿，用户在确认一个改动时看到的是它即将替换掉的旧名字。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台一个 hook；每个被卡片点名的已发布对象多 1 次草稿读取，之后每次对话推进最多再 1 次（实测见下）。回滚即还原 `changeCardLabels.ts` 一个文件。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts`（`findDraft` 的 `published` 参数与两个 resolver 的草稿优先分支）、`changeCardLabels.drafted-32984.test.tsx` 新增的 #34629 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/changeCardLabels.drafted-32984.test.tsx`，预期 16/16 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`useChangeCardLabels` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts`), the hook that names objects and fields on the AI chat's change card:

- A name the published registry knows now also asks the draft overlay (`GET /meta/object/:name?preview=draft`, the read the hook already makes for drafted names). The card shows the published label at once and the overlay's label once it answers. A label the draft did not change, and a failed overlay read, keep the published label.
- **The bound.** For a published name, the kept overlay answer is asked again once the conversation `revision` has moved since it was asked: a later change in the same conversation may relabel it, and a kept answer would show the old label without looking stale. It stays within #34472's bound: at most one overlay read per object per revision, none while one is in flight, none per render. Drafted-only names keep the earlier rule (asked again only when the kept answer does not name them).
- **The i18n wrapper.** `useObjectLabel`'s `objectLabel` / `fieldLabel` prefer a convention translation (`{ns}.objects.{name}.label`, `{ns}.fields.{object}.{field}`) over the label passed in (`resolve()` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` returns the translation when the key resolves). So a label the draft **changed** is returned as written, skipping that lookup: the translation was written for the published label the draft replaces, and would hide the new one. A label the draft did not change still goes through the translation, as before.

No `packages/spec`, server or metadata-protocol change, and no new server read: the overlay read is the one #34472 already makes.

### Request-count measurement

- **Per object:** +1 overlay read the first time a card names a published object (the object and its fields share it). Then at most +1 per object each time the conversation `revision` moves (`messages.length:turn|idle`, so up to about three times per turn: the send, the reply landing, the turn ending) while a card naming it is rendered. 0 while a read is in flight, 0 for re-renders at the same revision.
- **Live, one published object, two turns** (readings below; `GET /meta/object/NAME?preview=draft` counted with a Playwright request listener):

| | turn 1 (card: modify `due`) | idle renders after turn 1 | turn 2 (card: add `notes`, modify `due`) | conversation |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| before (main) | 0 | 0 | 2 (the drafted-only `notes` miss) | 2 |
| after | 2 | 0 | 3 | 5 |
| extra | +2 | 0 | +1 | +3 |

## Why

PR #34472 read the published registry first and the overlay only for names the registry did not know, so a published object or field relabelled in the same draft showed its published label on the card that confirms the change.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins (shared harness changeCardLabels.drafted-32984.test.tsx, new top-level describe), 16/16 green</summary>

New describe `objectstack#34629 — a published object or field the draft relabelled is named by its draft label`:

- a published object renamed in the draft shows the draft label;
- a published field relabelled in the draft shows the draft label (the object it did not rename keeps its published label);
- control: a published name with no draft change shows its published label after the overlay answers;
- control: a failed overlay read keeps the published label;
- a relabel drafted later in the same conversation is named on a later card;
- the bound: one overlay read per published object per revision, none while one is in flight (asks across renders and a revision move while the read is held add no read; after it settles, the one unasked revision costs one read, then none);
- with a convention translation (real `I18nProvider` + `createI18n` bundle): a draft relabel wins over the translation; control: a label the draft did not change still goes through the translation.

Fixture triage: the #32984 control `a published object and field answer from the registry, without a draft read` pinned exactly the branch this card changes (it asserted `overlayGet` was never called). It is replaced, not re-spelled: it now pins that the published label answers at once, before the overlay read settles, and that the read is made once.

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, one mutation per run, each restored to the HEAD blob 1dde4726)</summary>

The test imports the hook by relative path (`../changeCardLabels`), so the mutation is read from `src`; no build in the path.

| mutation | pins red |
|:---|:---|
| A: object resolver skips the overlay for a published name | 7 (object rename, both controls that wait on the read, later relabel, bound, both translation pins) |
| B: field resolver skips the overlay for a published field | 2 (field relabel, translation pin) |
| C: a published name's kept answer is not re-asked on a revision move | 2 (later relabel, bound) |
| D: draft-changed object label goes through the translation | 1 (draft relabel wins over the translation) |
| E: in-flight guard removed | 1 (bound) |

Each run printed `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0` and `ok restored: blob == HEAD (1dde472682d2) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

<details><summary>Other local runs</summary>

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/` (55 files): 55 passed, 386 tests passed.
- `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.copilotDoors-12894.test.tsx` (the other app-shell test that draws a change card): 6/6.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `npx eslint` on the two changed files from `ui/packages/app-shell`: exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The pending changeset `.changeset/32984-build-chat-labels-health.md` says "A published object still answers from the registry without a draft read", which this PR makes untrue. It is left untouched because the Version Packages PR (#33849) holds that file (overlap-check refused the edit); the new changeset states that it supersedes that sentence.
- Not measured: a session whose locale makes the server translate the labels it serves. Both the published read and the overlay read go through the same metadata client, so the draft-changed comparison compares like with like; whether the server applies a translation over a draft label in the overlay read was not read.
- The drafted-only rule (re-ask only on a miss) is unchanged, so a drafted-only object relabelled later in the same conversation still shows the label first read. That is #34472's behaviour, outside this card's published-name scope.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live reading: real console (Vite) over a real CRM example backend; only /api/v1/ai/** stubbed</summary>

Rig: `OS_HOME=SCRATCH pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm dev -- --fresh -p 4729`, console `DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4729 pnpm exec vite --port 5329 --strictPort --force`, Playwright standing in only for the EE AI service (agents, conversations, and an SSE stream that sends a `changes_proposed` envelope naming `NAME_task.due` by machine name, the way cloud's producer does). Per leg: install a package, save object `NAME_task` live (label "Task", field `due` "Due"), then draft a relabel with `?mode=draft` (object "Work item", field `due` "Deadline").

Backend, both legs: published read "Task" / "Due"; overlay read (`?preview=draft`) "Work item" / "Deadline"; `_drafts` lists the object.

- **Before** (main's `changeCardLabels.ts` served; served module checked for the old `findPublished(objectName) ?? findDraft(objectName)` line, vite restarted with `--force`): turn 1 card target `Task · Due`; turn 2 cards `Task · Due`, `Task · notes`, `Task · Due`.
- **After** (this branch): turn 1 card target `Work item · Deadline`; turn 2 cards `Work item · Deadline`, `Work item · notes`, `Work item · Deadline`. The card's tooltip keeps the machine name (`NAME_task.due`).

Request counts are in the table above. Screenshots and raw readings are kept with the seat (`34629-live/`: `before-1-card-turn1.png`, `before-2-card-turn2.png`, `after-1-card-turn1.png`, `after-2-card-turn2.png`, `*-readings.txt`, the rig script).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (change set from the merge base, 3 files): 38 derived commands, all run at head 05a450328, every one exit 0, plus `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` (roster under `.changeset/`) exit 0. Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero, every line records its exit code). `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-34629-change-card-draft-label`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` before the last push. CI families (Type Check UI, Test UI, Lint UI and the rest) are left to CI.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
